notes.title: Audio Factory v1.1: New controller visualizations for Vive and Oculus Touch
notes.content:
We have released a small but exciting improvement to Audio Factory today!

In our initial release a couple months ago we always visualized the Daydream controller, since we ported the app directly from Daydream. Today with this updated release, we support visualization of Vive and Oculus Touch controllers when using either of those controllers in Audio Factory :)

Enjoy!
